name: TRAWL
pin_reason: Camoufox is pinned to the version required by the current TRAWL release and upstream browser compatibility; update this when TRAWL moves to a newer tested Camoufox release.
description: TRAWL is a self-hosted scraping engine with adaptive HTTP, browser, challenge-solving, CAPTCHA, and proxy tiers. It exposes a FlareSolverr-compatible API for Prowlarr, Jackett, Sonarr, and Radarr, plus a native scraping API.

notes.text: The first start downloads the Camoufox browser and warms the browser pool; allow a few minutes before checking /health.

The optional MITM proxy is disabled and bound to localhost by default. If you enable it for another container, set MITM_PROXY_HOST=0.0.0.0 only on a trusted private network and install the CA certificate in the client.
TRAWL has no built-in authentication. Keep port 8191 on a trusted private network or put it behind an authenticated reverse proxy.
The default browser pool is one instance to fit the container defaults. Increase BROWSER_POOL_SIZE and the container RAM/CPU for concurrent scraping.
